research_limitations: Class P is observed F&B operation, NOT verified business success.
Class U is unlabeled commercial property, NOT verified negative.
Unverified geographic sampling, positive selection, geodata licensing, raster coverage and self-match are research limitations.
The 54-feature candidates include two building-density features, two age-share features and three bus/rail stop-count features from the verified recovered workbook.
Some age-sex locations have <80% source raster coverage; source QA flags must not be learned as outcome.
Transit distance nulls may be censored network searches and are not equivalent to zero.
Two bus-count correction locations and persistent geospatial network islands are described in source workbook provenance.
Official LandScan download should be linked to dataset-version terms and attribution; existing NO_PENDING_LICENCE flags have NOT been erased.
Parking P/U provenance differs; experiment is exploratory pending source methodology parity.
Positive F&B competitor self-exclusion is not independently verified; competitor sets are OPT-IN experimental.
Data-dependent feature selection over many configurations can lead to optimistic selection; evaluate future independent holdout.
No measured economic outcomes or current listing availability are available.
Feature imputation/scaling happens within every training bag and validation fold.

metadata.score_meaning: uncalibrated P-versus-U proxy association; not success probability
metadata.selection_rule: max pooled leave-one-state-out P-vs-U AUC, spatial AUC tiebreak
warnings: P is observed F&B outlet, U is an unlabeled commercial property, not failed business.
PU bagging score is not calibrated suitability or business success probability.
Selection on 12 variants makes validation performance optimistic; independent outcome-based validation is needed.
Source competitor self-exclusion and parking-method parity need independent QA.
Only use with permissioned inputs and exact feature extraction definitions.
Model predictions for these 955 U were generated on training records (in sample).
Availability UNKNOWN does not imply properties can currently be rented.
